name: rewrap-plus
description: Rewraps comments, docstrings, and string literals to a configured column limit, preserving formatted structure and emitting language-valid concatenation.

rewrapPlus.enable.markdownDescription: Global kill switch for Rewrap+. Turn this off to disable every wrap command and the range-formatting provider without hunting down each individual `#rewrapPlus.wrapComments#`/`#rewrapPlus.wrapStrings#`-style setting — the one to reach for when debugging a save pipeline with several formatters in it.

rewrapPlus.columnLimit.markdownDescription: Column to wrap at. `null` (the default) falls through to `#editor.rulers#` (language-scoped, then global), then `.editorconfig`'s `max_line_length`, then a built-in default of 80 — see the README's precedence table for the full chain. Supports a language-scoped override, e.g. `"[python]": { "rewrapPlus.columnLimit": 79 }`.

rewrapPlus.rulerIndex.markdownDescription: Which entry of `#editor.rulers#` to use as the column limit when `#rewrapPlus.columnLimit#` is `null` and more than one ruler is configured. Out of range falls back to the first ruler.

rewrapPlus.wrapStrings.markdownDescription: Wrap eligible string literals, subject to `#rewrapPlus.stringPolicy#`. **Not yet implemented** — string wrapping is a later phase of this project; this setting has no effect yet and is exposed now only so its schema and default are in place ahead of that work.

enumDescriptions: Never wrap strings, regardless of rewrapPlus.wrapStrings.
Wrap only strings that score as prose-like under the heuristic (paths, URLs, regexes, dict keys, and similar are left alone). The conservative default.
Wrap every eligible string, ignoring the prose heuristic.
rewrapPlus.stringPolicy.markdownDescription: How aggressively to wrap string literals once string wrapping is implemented. See `#rewrapPlus.wrapStrings#`.

enumDescriptions: Plain paragraph reflow only, no section structure.
rewrapPlus.docDialect.markdownDescription: Documentation dialect to assume for docstrings and doc comments. **Not yet implemented** — docstring dialect handling is a later phase of this project.

rewrapPlus.preserveIndentedBlocks.markdownDescription: Treat an already-indented block inside a comment or docstring (beyond a paragraph's first line) as verbatim rather than reflowing it — an aligned example or ASCII diagram is exactly what a wrong reflow guess mangles.

rewrapPlus.respectEditorConfig.markdownDescription: Consult `.editorconfig`'s `max_line_length` as a precedence tier for `#rewrapPlus.columnLimit#` resolution. Parsed directly by this extension, independent of whether the separate EditorConfig extension is installed.

rewrapPlus.balancedWrapping.markdownDescription: Use minimum-raggedness (balanced) line breaking instead of the default greedy first-fit. Often visibly nicer for short comments/docstrings, at the cost of more computation.

rewrapPlus.stringWrapInclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns scoping *string-literal* wrapping to specific paths, once implemented — lets string wrapping be trialled on one package or `docs/` before trusting it repo-wide. Does not affect comment wrapping. **Not yet implemented** — see `#rewrapPlus.wrapStrings#`.
